text: (1) Scanned copy of passport with a validity period of at least 18 months; for students from within China, a residence permit certificate for at least 30 days is required. (2) A valid health certificate issued by the designated local hospital for entry and exit, valid for no more than 6 months; (3) A criminal record certificate issued by the local police department, valid for no more than 6 months. (4) Highest educational qualification certificate / degree certificate; Note: If the applicant is a student or has already started employment, an additional document certifying the applicant's status as a student (such as a transfer certificate) or an employment certificate from the employer must be submitted. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be accompanied by a notarized translation in either Chinese or English. (5) Applicants are required to provide a transcript showing a total score of B grade (with a score ranging from 60% to 70%) or above in the high school graduation examination, a transcript showing an English subject score of more than 65% of the full score, or an IELTS score of 6.5; for applications for Chinese-taught programs, a transcript showing successful completion of the National or our university's "International Chinese Proficiency Standard" Level 4 examination is also required; for non-Chinese or non-English versions, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached. (6) Economic proof materials: A deposit certificate of at least $20,000 of equivalent value; (7) Self-introduction Video: A self-introduction video lasting at least 1 minute, in English; (8) Scanned copies of the identification documents of the economic guarantor and the person in charge of the matter in China; (9) For those applying for postgraduate studies, the following additional materials are required: undergraduate/master's degree transcripts, resumes in both Chinese and English, personal statements, and expert recommendation letters.
